title: Update on Number of Mpox Cases and Transmission Data
what_it_is: Update on Number of Mpox Cases and Transmission Data

sections.label: Mpox cases rise and decline
sections.summary: Mpox cases rose in late 2023 with global and regional increases, and no new Singapore cases were reported in January 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The increase in cases in the last quarter of 2023 corresponded with a rise in cases globally and regionally.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: No new mpox cases were reported in Singapore in January 2024.
